authority: The local Crusader control planes remain canonical. This API is a sanitized projection and is never the source of truth.

endpoints.name: cas-authority
endpoints.purpose: What currently governs CAS, by domain.

endpoints.name: cas-current-state
endpoints.purpose: CAS authority, missions, open decisions and published reports.

endpoints.name: decisions
endpoints.purpose: Open decisions awaiting a ruling, including Steve-only items.

endpoints.name: global-status
endpoints.purpose: Headline state of both businesses, index freshness and blockers.

endpoints.name: missions
endpoints.purpose: Every indexed mission, with active set and status counts.

endpoints.name: officer-commander
endpoints.purpose: Executive feed for GPT Crusader Commander.

endpoints.name: officer-cso
endpoints.purpose: Executive feed for GPT Chief Strategy Officer.

endpoints.name: officer-trading-director
endpoints.purpose: Executive feed for GPT Trading Director / Quant Architect.

endpoints.name: reports
endpoints.purpose: Published reports with pre-computed discovery slices.

endpoints.name: trading-authority
endpoints.purpose: What currently governs Trading, by domain.

endpoints.name: trading-current-state
endpoints.purpose: Trading authority, hard gates, research state and published reports.

endpoints.name: trading-hard-gates
endpoints.purpose: The five Trading hard gates. Absence of a gate is reported, never omitted.

freshness_contract: Every document carries generated_at (when this copy was built) and updated_at (when its content last changed). global-status.json carries the Command Center index freshness for both businesses. If generated_at is old, this is a stale COPY: say so rather than presenting it as current, and ask Steve to run the publish step.
purpose: Read-only executive state for the Crusader GPT officers. Every endpoint is a static JSON document generated from the local Crusader Command Center. There is no write method and no query string; discovery slices are pre-computed.
report_pages: published report HTML is linked from each report record as html_url, relative to https://stevefehr19.github.io/crusader-executive-api
